comment: Backend pluginIds this image registers STATICALLY, compiled into
these as already occupied, so a DYNAMIC backend-plugin claiming the same
pluginId is refused before it is ever mounted.
Why this file exists rather than a check at boot: Backstage DOES detect the
path deletes the whole slot -- so BOTH the static and the dynamic plugin
fail to initialize, and the default onPluginBootFailure ('abort') takes the
entire backend down. packages/backend/src/index.ts:230-233 records exactly
this happening for mcp-actions. Discovering it at boot is too late and too
expensive; this turns it into a refused install.
GENERATED -- do not hand-edit. Regenerate with:
Drift is caught by test_derive_static_backend_plugin_ids.py, which re-derives
from index.ts + node_modules and fails if this file disagrees.
Only createBackendPlugin registers a pluginId. createBackendModule entries
(24 of them here, all the catalog/scaffolder/search/auth modules) extend an
existing plugin and are deliberately absent -- several modules per pluginId
is normal and is not a collision.
